answer: Let distance be proven, not declared: an attestation only carries full weight if both peers attach signed round-trip timing samples that fit the regions they claim. Clones stacked on one rack measure microseconds between themselves, so a farm's whole trust web collapses into one wharf-side grove of a single node. Real spread demands machines on separate continents pushing real packets - a falcon shows its range by the stoop it makes, and each extra clone then costs hardware and bandwidth instead of a free vote.
